# Paths excluded from the trufflehog secret scan (--exclude-paths).
# One path regex per line.
#
# The ShellSpec suite holds fake credential-bearing URLs on purpose: many specs
# assert that brik REDACTS credentials (e.g. https://token@host -> https://***@host)
# or injects a token into a URL, so the fixtures must contain credential-shaped
# strings. They are not real secrets. Production code (bin/, lib/, shared-libs/)
# is still scanned.
^spec/
